observations.observation: The replacement APK resumes the existing attempt with one move already spent under the preceding APK. Local data is preserved.
The first swap in this APK completes a yellow L match and normal cascades, naturally leaving TNT at (2,2) and a rocket at (1,3).
A real direct TNT tap consumes one move and clears targets with normal resolution and refill.
A normal yellow square creates a propeller that falls to (4,4).
Another ordinary square naturally creates the propeller at (3,5).
Further ordinary right-board matches and cascades naturally produce the vertical rocket at (5,8).
Swapping that rocket down activates it and removes grass while spending one move.
Dragging the natural propeller left activates its neighborhood and targeted flight.
A normal match and cascades leave only three isolated targets and create a horizontal rocket at (7,0).

The final propeller swipe and cascades complete the remaining targets. The HUD check and King thumbs-up are visible. This is the fourteenth accepted fifth-level move in this APK, fifteenth in the resumed attempt.
The unskipped reward phase starts with the base reward and original remaining move count.
All 15 remaining moves convert automatically; board powers activate and reward coins fly without skip input.
The reward counter settles at 54 and the result popup begins its entrance animation.
The complete Level 5 / Well Done / Continue result is visible.
The actual Continue button opens the sixth original board with two separated four-column portions. No new tutorial popup is observed.
Home / force-stop of this package / cold launch retains the displayed level, board classes and counters; pixel and heuristic differences are documented separately.
After the cold restart, a real legal swap on the right board clears grass, cascades and refills normally.

limits: The source manifest and generated IL2CPP C++ include the native shuffle final-frame correction. This Android route does not trigger a shuffle, so device shuffle motion parity remains unverified; the native/Unity comparisons remain in runtime_shuffle_motion_evidence.json.

This APK resumes a normal fifth-level attempt with its first accepted move already spent under the preceding APK. Fourteen additional normal moves finish it here. No board/power/save edits, fixtures or move-budget overrides are used.

The screenshot classifier assists operator gesture selection only and is not shipped. It scores color groups approximately and requires manual review, especially for special items and separated groups.

The sixth-level cold restart retains the visible board classes and 35/72 counters. One of 72 center patches differs at a purple hint, and the grass-edge classifier differs at (0,4). Exact rendered, grass-mask or saved-model byte equality is not claimed.

This round naturally completes level 5 and verifies entry/restoration/input at level 6. It does not naturally complete all 100 levels or exercise every obstacle, tutorial, Android bonus or Jester branch.

Original-device image/audio/input parity and physical ARM64-device execution remain unverified. The original-app consent state, user phone and unrelated user editor remain untouched. Full scope completion remains false.
